title: I'm Begining To See The Light
lyrics_synced:
[01:00.60] I never cared much for moonlit skies,
[01:03.80] I never wink back at fire flies
[01:07.00] But now that the stars are in your eyes,
[01:09.90] I'm beginning to see the light.
[01:13.40] I never went in for after glow,
[01:16.60] Or candlelight on the mistletoe,
[01:19.80] But now when you turn the lamp down low,
[01:22.70] I'm beginning to see the light.
[01:26.60] Used to ramble thru the park,
[01:29.80] Shaddow boxing in the dark,
[01:33.00] Then you came and caused a spark,
[01:35.50] That's a four alarm fire now!
[01:39.00] I never made love by lantern shine,
[01:42.20] I never saw rainbows in my wine,
[01:45.40] But now that your lips are burning mine,
[01:48.30] I'm beginning to see the light.
